column1: # raea fix's own entries (read by systems/fixes, raea-sys-fixes): problems found and fixed in raea work,
# searched before the library and shown first. Columns: problem, cause, fix, error text, domains, where and when found.
# Add one when a fix was confirmed on a frame; remove one when the engine fixes its cause.
Additive glow draws nothing
column2: `unlit` shows only `base_color`, so an emissive on an unlit material is dropped
column3: Leave `unlit` off an additive glow (`base_color="#000000" alpha_mode="Add" emissive=...`) and use `perceptual_roughness={1} reflectance={0}` instead.

column1: Emissive texture draws nothing, the surface stays black
column2: A 1-channel (greyscale) or palettised PNG as `emissive_texture`
column3: Save it as RGB (`magick in.png -type TrueColor PNG24:out.png`), or draw it with `base_color_texture` on an `unlit` white material. Confirm on a frame.

column1: Radial stripes across additive cone or beam layers
column2: Additive layers pick up the lights' specular highlights
column3: Give additive layers `reflectance={0}`.

column1: A simulated or per-frame BufferMesh stands still
column2: The engine keeps the first geometry it saw under a name
column3: Give a `BufferMesh` whose positions change a per-frame `name` and key, e.g. ``name={`sheet-${Math.round(t * 30)}`}``.

column1: Text3D words sit half a word left of where they were placed
column2: A `Text3D`'s origin is the word's middle, not its left edge
column3: Lay words out by their centres (add half the word's width when placing from a left edge).

column1: Sky, horizon or distant city cut off a short way out
column2: The camera's far plane is nearer than the scene (200 m in some looks, while a sky dome was 188 m across)
column3: Raise the camera's `far` above the scene's extent.

column1: Emissive type or glow vanishes in a night scene
column2: Emissive on a lit material is multiplied by the view's exposure, which a dark scene raises
column3: Make white type in the dark `unlit` (its `base_color` draws at full strength).

column1: Paint look: a shot from far away is greyed out
column2: The paint look's haze is one colour for the whole frame
column3: Set `hazeMost={0}` for shots from a distance (a long lens standing in for an orthographic camera).

column1: Solari: a sun added after the first frame lights nothing
column2: A `DirectionalLight` spawned after a render's first frame isn't traced; one present from frame 0 keeps its frame-0 strength (its direction follows)
column3: Keep one sun from frame 0 at full strength and vary only its direction (aim it up from under the floor where there should be none).

column1: Solari: frames rendered with --at far apart lose the sun and fog shadows
column2: A jump of more than about 4.5 s between two drawn frames leaves stale ray-tracing data for every later frame
column3: Render stills one per render, and a film a shot per render (a `<Composition>` per shot), joined with a re-encode.

column1: A temporal effect looks wrong on an --at still but right in the video
column2: `raea render --at` draws none of the frames between the listed ones, so Solari, the denoiser and TAA have almost no history
column3: For anything temporal, render every frame to a directory (`-o dir/`, no `--at`) and pick frames from it. `--at` output files are numbered from 0 in list order.

column1: Solari: dark arcs or patches drift on walls after a light jumps
column2: MetalFX's temporal denoiser carries history across the jump; `reset: true` also resets the denoiser and makes it worse
column3: Change no light faster than about 0.2 of its level a frame: ramp strikes (about 40 frames, eased), ease flicker dips, fade blow-outs over about 12 frames.

column1: A ShaderExtension's animation is frozen on its first frame
column2: A `ShaderExtension`'s uniforms are the first frame's, and `globals.time` doesn't advance in stills
column3: Carry time through an animated material value: `animate={{ emissive: track(KEYS) }}` with a key every frame on the base StandardMaterial, read in the shader as `material.emissive.r`.

column1: Splats draw each other's data or garbage slabs when one mounts or unmounts
column2: Splats swap data when one unmounts and another mounts
column3: Keep every `<Splat>` in the tree from the first frame and park the unused ones off stage (far `position`, `opacity={0}`).

column1: A splat prop keeps an old value
column2: A splat prop left out of a frame keeps its last value
column3: Give every animated splat prop on every frame.

column1: --w, --h or --frames are ignored by raea render
column2: The file has a `<Composition>`, whose size and length win
column3: Set `width`, `height` and `durationInFrames` on the `<Composition>`.

column1: mix-blend-mode on a child draws blocky rectangles that move
column2: `mixBlendMode` on a child inside an `overflow: hidden`, `clipPath` or rotated box is drawn in mismatched rectangles (an engine gap)
column3: Use `backgroundImage` + `backgroundBlendMode` + `backgroundColor` on the card's own element, or bake the colour into the texture (ffmpeg `lutrgb`).

column1: A long MP4 render is refused at the end after rendering everything
column2: Past 4 GB the MP4 writer has no 64-bit mdat (grain or noise at `--quality high` on a long film)
column3: Pass an explicit bitrate, e.g. `--kbps 40000`, instead of `--quality high`.
column4: MP4 MDAT box size exceeds u32::MAX

column1: raea run prints nothing: no console.log, no result
column2: `raea run` shows neither console output nor the default export's value; a thrown error prints only its stack, which leaves the message out
column3: Throw what you want to read as the stack: `throw Object.assign(new Error(m), { stack: m })`.

column1: raea run stops a script after two minutes
column2: `raea run` stops a script after 120 s by default
column3: Pass `--timeout SECONDS` (e.g. `--timeout 400`).

column1: A WGSL pass silently does nothing although the render reports 0 errors
column2: A reserved WGSL word used as a name: `shared` (as a module file name), `filter` (as an entry point); also `common`, `smooth`, `target`, `module`, `meta`, `set`. Bevy logs the error once
column3: Rename it, and search the log for the shader error rather than trusting the error count.

column1: Poly Haven glTF plants render every leaf card as a solid quad
column2: The base colour is a JPEG named diff-alpha, but JPEG carries no alpha
column3: Fetch the set's Alpha map, composite it into the diffuse as an RGBA PNG (`magick diff ( alpha -colorspace gray ) -alpha off -compose CopyOpacity -composite PNG32:out.png`) and set the material's alpha to MASK (BLEND isn't instanced by `<Instances>`).

column1: raea show says the running app is older than raea show, but it isn't
column2: ~/.raea/app-host.json, which names the app's host, went missing
column3: Find the host's port (`pgrep -fl host.mjs`, its `--port N`) and run `RAEA_FEED_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:N raea show ...`; no restart needed.

column1: Bevy: a glTF's animation compiles and plays but the bones don't move
column2: A fresh entity with `AnimationPlayer` and `AnimationGraphHandle` isn't the player the glTF's bones are bound to
column3: Spawn the scene with `WorldAssetRoot`, observe `On<WorldInstanceReady>`, find the loader's `AnimationPlayer` among the scene's descendants, insert the `AnimationGraphHandle` there and play (Bevy's `examples/animation/animated_mesh.rs`).

column1: A GLB from Blender's web export doesn't load in Bevy
column2: Bevy 0.20's glTF loader doesn't support `EXT_meshopt_compression`, which Blender's web export marks required
column3: Export without meshopt (`export_meshopt_compression_enable=false`) for anything but three.js.

column1: Bevy can't load assets outside assets/
column2: The asset server reads only under `assets/` by default
column3: Set `AssetPlugin { file_path, .. }` (or `unapproved_path_mode`).

column1: Blender clips start a frame late, and a loop holds its first pose at every seam
column2: The glTF export keeps the action's start frame
column3: Export with `export_anim_slide_to_zero=true`.

column1: A looping Blender animation dips or flattens at its ends
column2: Auto-clamped handles flatten at the first and last keys
column3: Add a `CYCLES` F-curve modifier before baking; `bake_action` and the glTF exporter read the evaluated curve.

column1: Blender turntable renders overexposed by about two stops under AgX
column2: The skill's `turntable.py` studio rig scales the key with distance squared
column3: Lower `view_settings.exposure` (about -2) or the lights' power, and check the 18% grey backdrop reads grey. It also resets the frame range to 1-120.

column1: three.js can't find a bone by its Blender name
column2: GLTFLoader strips `.` from node names: `hand.R` arrives as `handR`
column3: Look bones up by the stripped name (remove dots from Blender's).

column1: three.js: a skinned mesh's limb pops out of view when animated
column2: Skinned meshes are culled by their bind-pose bounds
column3: Set `frustumCulled = false` on skinned meshes, or grow their bounds to the clip's.
